design_exclusions.interpretation: project composition design constraint; not a toxicity or safety determination

estimand: equal-weight reduced compositions represented by each composition's lowest recorded valid-ehull structure in this snapshot; not all polymorphs or all real materials

families.chalcogenide: contains S or Se and contains none of O, N, F, Cl, Br, I
families.other: all remaining compositions; excluded from the comparison
families.oxide: contains O and contains none of S, Se, N, F, Cl, Br, I

hypotheses.h1: chalcogenide observed pass rate minus oxide observed pass rate > 0
hypotheses.h2: chalcogenide observed pass rate minus oxide observed pass rate <= 0

inference.interval: 95% percentile; composition-level resampling with replacement within each family
inference.interval_scope: resampling stability in this snapshot, not population uncertainty for real materials
inference.quality_gate_non_degenerate: both family endpoints must contain pass and fail compositions

status_rules.data_limited: any sample size or coverage gate fails
status_rules.inconclusive: quality gates pass but interval includes zero or a family endpoint is degenerate
status_rules.reversed_in_snapshot: all quality gates pass and interval upper bound < 0
status_rules.supported_in_snapshot: all quality gates pass and interval lower bound > 0

primary_endpoint.observable: finite OPT band gap and finite valid ehull
primary_endpoint.unknown_handling: not evaluable; reported through complete-case rate and worst-case missingness bounds

primary_method: OPT band gap only; source key optb88vdw_bandgap; never coalesce with MBJ
question: Under the fixed JARVIS snapshot and screening rule, how do observed composition pass rates compare between oxide and chalcogenide families?
representative_rule: per reduced composition, choose the lowest finite ehull >= -1e-6 eV/atom; set values in [-1e-6,0) to zero; ties use lexicographically smallest jid; if every ehull is invalid or missing choose lexicographically smallest jid and retain as unevaluable; never inspect a band gap when selecting

source_semantics.units_and_definition: JARVIS energy above hull in eV/atom; see cited NIST JARVIS methods paper

split.method: sorted eligible composition keys permuted by NumPy default_rng(seed) independently per family; floor(0.70*n) discovery; remaining keys holdout
